inputs.text: Close-up 2D anime illustration of a young adult woman framed from the chest up in a slight three-quarter view beside a softly glowing vending machine at night. She has a delicate narrow pale face, large dark almond-shaped eyes, a small straight nose, and small slightly parted lips. Her defining hairstyle is sleek glossy jet-black medium-length hair forming a rounded bob, with dense full blunt bangs cut straight across her forehead, smooth heavy side sections framing her cheeks, and prominent outward-curving ends on both sides that create a distinctive symmetrical graphic silhouette. She wears large dark over-ear headphones with subtle metallic accents; the headphones, hair silhouette, and face are the key identity markers. Her expression is calm, cool, and slightly distant, with one hand lightly touching one earcup. Soft cool vending-machine light shapes her face, a restrained rim light separates the black hair from a simple dark urban background, and the image uses refined clean linework, controlled cel shading, smooth graphic shapes, and subtle atmospheric reflections. Clothing is secondary and understated.
